draft.subject: Corlane Medical is 17.4% of your wealth
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

There is one figure I would like you to see. Corlane Medical Systems is now 17.4% of your wealth with us, in a single holding.

You told us at the outset that you wanted to avoid single-stock risk, and this is the one place in the portfolio where it has crept back in. It is also a company in the same field as your practice, so your income and a sizeable part of your savings now depend on the same industry.

What I would suggest is that we look at it together and you decide whether it is a position you want to keep. If it is, nothing needs to change and I will note your decision; if not, we can plan to reduce it gradually.

Could I call you this week?
